caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers, rendered in shades of brown with visible wood grain patterns giving a textured appearance. The chest features four main horizontal drawers, each with two round knobs, and a smaller, two-drawer compartment situated on top at the center, also with round knobs. The entire structure is rectangular with straight lines, showing symmetry in its design and drawer placement. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is an additional rectangular inset sketch in black outline labeled "Side View," illustrating the side profile of the chest, including the smaller top compartment and the main body. The background of the drawing is light beige or off-white, and the objects are centered on the page.
title: Old Dresser
